sloka: अमनाः तेन शोकेन राम शोकेन च प्रभुः ।द्वाभ्यामपि महाराजः शोकाब्यामभितप्यतो ॥२-६२-५॥
transliteration: amanāḥ tena śokena rāma śokena ca prabhuḥ ।dvābhyāmapi mahārājaḥ śokābyāmabhitapyato ॥2-62-5॥

translations.english: The great king, the lord with a broken heart started regretting deeply about both the grievous acts he had committed previously (one is shooting at the son of a sage and the other, banishing Rama).
